result.instructions: Tools for StatusCast, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is anything on our status page degraded right now?"; "Show all incidents from the last 30 days and how long each lasted."; "What was the uptime of our API component last month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes StatusCast data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run statuscast_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run statuscast_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run statuscast_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. statuscast_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: statuscast_get_page_status
tools.title: Get page status
tools.description: Get the overall status of the status page: status, status text and since when it is in effect. Good first call. StatusCast API: GET /api/v4/page/status.

tools.name: statuscast_get_page
tools.title: Get page details
tools.description: Get the name, domain, CNAME, logo and date format of a status page by its numeric page id (the pageId from statuscast_get_page_status). StatusCast API: GET /api/v4/page/{id}.

tools.name: statuscast_list_components
tools.title: List components
tools.description: List all components (services) with id, name, parent, status (Available, DegradedPerformance, Unavailable, Maintenance, Investigating, Identified, Monitoring, Informational) and hidden flag. StatusCast API: GET /api/v4/components.

tools.name: statuscast_search_components
tools.title: Search components
tools.description: Search components with paging and filters: text, parent, children, sort order. Use it when the component list is large. StatusCast API: POST /api/v4/components.

text_search.description: Match this text in the component name.

parent_id.description: Only components under this parent component id.

include_children.description: Include child components of the parent.

tools.name: statuscast_get_component
tools.title: Get component
tools.description: Get one component by id: name, description, parent, status and linked components. StatusCast API: GET /api/v4/component/{id}.

tools.name: statuscast_get_component_uptime
tools.title: Get component uptime
tools.description: Get the uptime percentage of one component for a date range, with the incident ids and the downtime periods. StatusCast API: GET /api/v4/component/{id}/uptime.

range.description: Date range for the uptime figure.

group_id.description: Subscriber group id to scope the figure.

tools.name: statuscast_search_incidents
tools.title: Search incidents
tools.description: Search incidents and maintenance events with filters (status, keyword, component ids, date window) and paging. Returns items with title, type, status, dates and posts. StatusCast API: POST /api/v4/incidents.

keyword.description: Match this text in the incident.

incident_status_by.description: Incident state filter. OpenStarted = open and started now.

component_ids.description: Only incidents that affect these component ids.

group_ids.description: Only incidents of these subscriber group ids.

external_id.description: Match the external id set by an integration.

tools.name: statuscast_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get one incident by id with all its posts (updates), affected components and groups. StatusCast API: GET /api/v4/incident/{id}.

tools.name: statuscast_list_group_incidents
tools.title: List group incidents
tools.description: List the incidents of one subscriber group by group id. StatusCast API: GET /api/v4/groupincidents/{id}.

tools.name: statuscast_list_content_templates
tools.title: List content templates
tools.description: List the incident content templates: event, status, post type, linked components and groups, subject and body. StatusCast API: GET /api/v4/contenttemplate.
